plain_text:
Raymond Edward Johnson appears in 65 recordings across 13 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1941 to 1971. The credits here include performer and host.

In this archive, you will hear Raymond Edward Johnson most often in Inner Sanctum Mysteries, Cloak and Dagger, X Minus One, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Casey, Crime Photographer, Dimension X, Gang Busters, and Barrie Craig.

Characters credited here include The Inner Sanctum Host.
